tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background and header. The darkest dark surface step.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: hover on a text button, table stripes, menu item hover (light).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: The four left-column boxes (Toolbox, save box, Beads needed, Saved Patterns). Modal and menu fill in dark.

tokens.name: panel-line
tokens.usage: Left-column box borders (invisible in dark); the Toolbox's own button borders; message border in light.

tokens.name: panel-rule
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a box: above and below the Mirror and Size disclosure rows.

tokens.name: elevated
tokens.usage: Buttons and thumbnail circles inside a box; the modal surface and menu hover in dark. The lightest dark surface step.

tokens.name: pill
tokens.usage: The read-only Bead pill in the header.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on canvas, panel, box and elevated (16:1 and up in both themes).

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Secondary text such as Beads needed color names, on panel and elevated.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels and meta (DM Mono), inactive tab labels, chevrons, on panel, box and elevated (4.8:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: "/ RU" in the language button and the inactive theme icon (4.5:1 on canvas).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons (Image colors while the Pattern has none). Exempt from contrast as disabled.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Header bottom border; row dividers inside boxes (Beads needed rows, the Saved Patterns footer).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Button and select borders on the page, expand buttons, the Tools tab rule, thin scrollbar thumb; the overlay border in dark. Fields and Steppers use field-line.

tokens.name: field-line
tokens.usage: Borders that are the only edge of a control: TextField, NumberField, Select, Stepper (3.7:1 light, 3.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: the single most likely next action in a region (New Pattern, Replace bead, Save Pattern, Row done), the active tool, the current row, the brand mark, the selected Saved Pattern. Nothing else is accent-colored. As a fill and in the logo; for text and thin marks on light surfaces use accent-strong.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed fill and border. Light is lighter than accent (#ff6a2b) so the dark label keeps 5.8:1.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Accent as text and thin marks on light surfaces: the active tool label and underline, the open Saved Pattern ring and name, message edges and accent icons, links (4.9:1 on panel). Dark: the same yellow as accent.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 2px, 2px away (3px in high contrast). 4.9:1 on panel in light, 16:1 in dark.

tokens.name: accent-disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Disabled primary button fill.

tokens.name: accent-disabled-fg
tokens.usage: Disabled primary button text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover: dark in both themes (4.9:1 on light orange, 18:1 on dark yellow). The logo on an accent tile stays white (a graphic, 3.3:1).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The selected palette swatch's outer ring (inner gap in panel).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete all, error text, the error message edge, danger-filled confirm buttons (their label is on-danger). 4.9:1 on panel in light, 4.6:1 in dark.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on danger-filled buttons: white in light (5.5:1), near-black in dark (5.0:1 on #ef4444).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning message edge and the Estimated size warning (Derived). Never as text.

tokens.name: swatch-edge
tokens.usage: Inset 1px edge on every swatch so ivory and black swatches do not vanish.

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill on the page (header): EN / RU, theme toggle frame, keyboard shortcuts.

tokens.name: button-line
tokens.usage: Secondary button border on the page.

tokens.name: box
tokens.usage: Canvas box background.

tokens.name: box-line
tokens.usage: Canvas box border.

tokens.name: box-muted
tokens.usage: Meta text in the canvas box header strip and Progress bar. Strip dividers are this at 22% opacity.

tokens.name: box-button
tokens.usage: Button fill in the Progress bar (transparent in light).

tokens.name: box-button-line
tokens.usage: Button border in the Progress bar.

tokens.name: switch-off
tokens.usage: The Switch track while off (3.5:1 light, 4.1:1 dark on box).

tokens.name: board
tokens.usage: The rounded board the beads sit on (PatternTheme background).

tokens.name: ruler
tokens.usage: Row and column numbers on the canvas rulers (5.2:1 light, 4.9:1 dark on box); the current row's number uses marker.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Current-row outline and its ruler number; PatternTheme marker.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Progress bar track.

tokens.name: word
tokens.usage: The background technique word ("Loom") behind the board.

tokens.name: print-board
tokens.usage: The board behind the chart in PDF and PNG exports. Exports are always light, so it is the same in every theme.

tokens.name: curve
tokens.usage: The 1.5px decorative curve behind the board.

tokens.name: bead-rim
tokens.usage: Faint 0.75px rim drawn around each bead in light; none in dark (drawn in the board color).

tokens.name: bead-empty
tokens.usage: An empty bead position on the board (Derived).

tokens.name: bead-seam
tokens.usage: The seam line in brick stitch patterns.

tokens.name: bead-outline
tokens.usage: Hover outline when no color is chosen.

tokens.name: tour-highlight
tokens.usage: The Tour: the 2.5px ring (with an 8px glow at 38%) on the control to use next, the tool tile tint and the current bead in the step strand. 3px ink ring, no glow, in high contrast.

tokens.name: note-gold
tokens.usage: Overview only: the decorative note under the Tour Pattern band. About 2.5:1 on white, so never for text that carries meaning.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: "bd-beads" in the header, beside the accent bead glyph.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, selects, row labels (Mirror, Size), box titles, "Row 12", "Pattern".

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Text, Beads needed rows, modal and message body.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tool tab labels under their icons; small buttons (Custom, Image colors).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Saved Pattern names under thumbnails; tooltips.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Group labels ("tools", "colors", "edit"), "currently editing", "saved · this device". Lowercased by text-transform, never in the string.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Values next to a label: "l–r 1 · t–b 0", "64×48 mm", "40 columns · 30 rows", counts, "100%". Lowercased by style.

styles.name: meta-small
styles.usage: "qr · png · pdf", "5 of 12". Lowercased by style.

styles.name: ruler
styles.usage: Canvas rulers: every row and column number; every 5th bold in body, the rest regular in ruler, the current row weight 700 in marker; column numbers from 100 turned a quarter turn; 12px on a phone. See the Rulers card.

styles.name: word
styles.usage: The background technique word only, italic, in word color, anchored bottom-right behind the board.

styles.name: tagline
styles.usage: Overview only: the slogan. 40px on the phone, 58px from 744, 60px from 1024, 70px at 24″; Russian 20% smaller. The last word in accent-strong.

styles.name: serif-heading
styles.usage: Overview only: section headings ("What's inside", "Three ways to use it") and plan names (30px); 42px from 744 below 1024.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Overview only: handwritten notes beside things ("you", "on us", "eleven small steps"), 15–19px, muted or accent-strong, with a 1.25px hand-drawn arrow. Decorative, aria-hidden.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight control groups (theme toggle padding and gap).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Base unit. Menu padding; gap from a button to its menu.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Buttons in the Edit row and swatch grid; tight control groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Buttons in a row; label to its group's content.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Header gap between items; save box label to its content; disclosure row padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Canvas strip gap; Progress bar gap; message padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Left column to canvas box; Beads needed / Saved Patterns padding; board padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between left-column boxes; save box padding (vertical); message padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Gap between Tool groups; save box and panel horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page padding (top/bottom); Toolbox padding; modal padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Page padding (left/right); header horizontal padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: kbd hints.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Swatches, zoom buttons, theme-toggle buttons, menu items, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, selects, the theme toggle frame, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Every box, the canvas box, modals, messages.

tokens.name: radius-board
tokens.usage: The bead board.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, the switch, round icon buttons, thumbnails, the progress track.

shadow.note: Light separates surfaces with hairlines and a few soft shadows; dark uses no shadows, depth comes from the surface steps canvas → surface → panel → elevated.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Card: save box, Beads needed, Saved Patterns. Dark uses surface steps instead.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: The canvas box.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: Modals, menus, messages (Derived). Dark adds a 1px line-strong border instead.

components.OverflowMenu: responsive sign-off (hand-written); archived in v15, replaced by HeaderMenu

layout.note: Screen tiers and the sizes that change between them. Media queries cannot read custom properties: mirror the four breakpoints as literal min-width values.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: iPad mini tier and up (iPad mini, iPad and 11″ iPads upright). Below it: the phone tier.

tokens.name: bp-tablet-lg
tokens.usage: iPad 13″ tier and up (13″ iPads upright, smaller iPads sideways): the left column docks again.

tokens.name: bp-laptop
tokens.usage: MacBook Air tier and up: the reference layout from DESIGN.md.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: 24″ displays and larger: wider column, more room for the Pattern.

tokens.name: bp-phone-landscape
tokens.usage: max-height: a phone on its side keeps the phone layout with the dock as a side rail, whatever its width.

tokens.name: column-width-tablet-lg
tokens.usage: Left column at the iPad 13″ tier (286px boxes).

tokens.name: column-width
tokens.usage: Left column at the MacBook Air tier (312px boxes plus a 14px scrollbar gutter).

tokens.name: column-width-desktop
tokens.usage: Left column at 24″ and up (344px boxes).

tokens.name: drawer-width
tokens.usage: The left column as a drawer at the iPad mini tier.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Header at iPad mini and up.

tokens.name: header-height-phone
tokens.usage: Header on a phone; 44px in landscape.

tokens.name: dock-height
tokens.usage: Phone dock and iPad mini bottom toolbar, plus env(safe-area-inset-bottom).

tokens.name: progress-height-phone
tokens.usage: Progress bar on a phone, plus its 3px progress line.

tokens.name: bead-min-phone
tokens.usage: Smallest bead at the Phone tier (0–743px): the zoom-out floor and the most Fit may shrink to, so every ruler number stays clear. Bead width without the 2px gap (pitch 18px). Set for the phone's 12px ruler numbers (15px would do for 11px). Holds for Patterns to 999 columns, because numbers from 100 are turned. A wider Pattern is panned, not shrunk.

tokens.name: bead-min-tablet
tokens.usage: Smallest bead at the iPad mini tier tier (744–1023px): the zoom-out floor and the most Fit may shrink to, so every ruler number stays clear. Bead width without the 2px gap (pitch 17px). Holds for Patterns to 999 columns, because numbers from 100 are turned. A wider Pattern is panned, not shrunk.

tokens.name: bead-min-tablet-lg
tokens.usage: Smallest bead at the iPad 13″ tier tier (1024–1279px): the zoom-out floor and the most Fit may shrink to, so every ruler number stays clear. Bead width without the 2px gap (pitch 17px). Holds for Patterns to 999 columns, because numbers from 100 are turned. A wider Pattern is panned, not shrunk.

tokens.name: bead-min-laptop
tokens.usage: Smallest bead at the MacBook Air tier tier (1280–1919px): the zoom-out floor and the most Fit may shrink to, so every ruler number stays clear. Bead width without the 2px gap (pitch 17px). Holds for Patterns to 999 columns, because numbers from 100 are turned. A wider Pattern is panned, not shrunk.

tokens.name: bead-min-desktop
tokens.usage: Smallest bead at the 24″ and larger tier (1920px and up): the zoom-out floor and the most Fit may shrink to, so every ruler number stays clear. Bead width without the 2px gap (pitch 17px). Holds for Patterns to 999 columns, because numbers from 100 are turned. A wider Pattern is panned, not shrunk.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for every control on a coarse pointer (touch, Pencil).

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Text, number and select fields, Steppers and form buttons: taller than the 34px controls because people type and read in them.

tokens.name: field-height-phone
tokens.usage: Form buttons (Create Pattern, Convert image) on a phone.

tokens.name: loading-delay
tokens.usage: Wait before any loading indicator appears, so fast work never flashes.

zIndex.note: Which layer sits above which. Steps of 10; a scrim sits one below its layer.

tokens.name: z-canvas-overlay
tokens.usage: Rulers, current-row marker, Selection, paste preview, ZoomPill: inside the canvas box.

tokens.name: z-chrome
tokens.usage: Header, Dock, BottomToolbar, Progress bar when they overlap scrolling content.

tokens.name: z-context-bar
tokens.usage: The Selection ContextBar above the Progress bar.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: The iPad mini Drawer and its scrim (scrim one below).

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: ToolSheets; the modal Pattern sheet and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, the Image colors popover, OverflowMenu.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast messages: above sheets so a result is never hidden, below modals.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and their scrim (scrim one below): confirmations, QR export, Keyboard shortcuts, New Pattern on phone.

tokens.name: z-tour-dim
tokens.usage: The Tour's dim layer and its hole (v15): above modals so the Tour can guide inside New Pattern on the phone.

tokens.name: z-tour-connector
tokens.usage: The Tour's ring of beads around the hole and the connector to the card.

tokens.name: z-tour-card
tokens.usage: The Tour's step card and final card; below tooltips.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips: always on top, never interactive.

print.note: PDF and PNG exports. The PDF is A4 portrait, drawn at 150 dpi; the PNG is sized in pixels.

tokens.name: print-page-width
tokens.usage: A4 portrait.

tokens.name: print-page-height
tokens.usage: A4 portrait.

tokens.name: print-dpi
tokens.usage: Each PDF page is drawn at this resolution and embedded as one picture.

tokens.name: print-margin
tokens.usage: Page margin on every side.

tokens.name: print-header
tokens.usage: Chart page header: technique word and name, part, maker, date and time, page number, mini map.

tokens.name: print-footer
tokens.usage: Footer: the brand, and where the chart continues.

tokens.name: print-name-band
tokens.usage: Band under the chart board for the maker's name and the accent line.

tokens.name: print-bead-base
tokens.usage: Bead size that decides how many chart pages a Pattern takes.

tokens.name: print-bead-max
tokens.usage: Largest bead after a part is enlarged to fill its page.

tokens.name: print-legend-width
tokens.usage: Page 1 column: Beads needed (beads and grams) and the facts.

tokens.name: print-line-width
tokens.usage: The background accent line, at print-line-opacity.

tokens.name: print-line-opacity
tokens.usage: Accent line strength on paper.

tokens.name: print-mark-opacity
tokens.usage: The large background X1 mark; the medium and small ones use 0.08 and 0.1.

tokens.name: print-name-opacity
tokens.usage: The maker's name set large under the canvas.

tokens.name: print-png-bead
tokens.usage: Bead size in the PNG, fewer pixels when the picture would pass 16 megapixels.
